title: Sounds of the 60s with Tony Blackburn
description: Tony brings you two hours of music from the best decade ever, with hits from The Move, The Beatles and Dusty Springfield. This week, the top three comes from 1963.

title: Dermot O'Leary
description: Radiohead's Thom Yorke, and co-creators Christine Jones and Steven Hoggett, chat about Hamlet: Hail To The Thief.

title: Romesh Ranganathan
description: Gaten Matarazzo, star of Stranger Things, joins Romesh live in the studio to talk about his starring role in 'Rent'.

title: Ellie Taylor
description: Spend Saturday lunchtime with Ellie. Whether you're out and about or chilling at home, Ellie is standing by to speak to you and hit shuffle on all your favourite music.

title: Rylan on Saturday
description: Rylan will be having an S Club Party! They'll pop in to talk about their forthcoming tour and see if the Rylexa spits out AI or Lie facts. And, of course, there'll be some KaRYoke.

title: Sounds of the 80s with Gary Davies
description: A special sax-filled show in celebration of International Saxophone Day! With guests Nick Heyward and saxophonist Leo Green choosing their Top 3 80s saxophone tunes.

title: Festival of Remembrance 2026
description: In a special live programme for Remembrance weekend, Paddy O'Connell brings highlights from the Festival of Remembrance at the Royal Albert Hall, reflective interviews and music.

title: Sounds of the 90s with Fearne Cotton
description: Our very own Jeremy Vine joins Fearne in the studio to look back at his 90s memories, to pick some favourite songs and to have a mini 90s rave.

title: Dance Sounds of the 90s with Vernon Kay
description: Living legend from Livin' Joy Tameko Star joins Vernon to share her 90s memories.

title: Alternative Sounds of the 90s with Dermot O'Leary
description: We celebrate Creation Records with bands including Oasis, Primal Scream & Teenage Fanclub.

title: Quincy Jones: Forty Thousand Years of Funk
description: DJ Spoony presents another chance to hear 'Forty Thousand Years of Funk' exploring the legacy of Quincy Jones.

title: Tony Blackburn's Sounds of Soul
description: Tony's back with a stunning selection of soul-soaked tracks from across the decades. Includes beautiful music from Barbara Tucker, Jill Scott, The Real Thing, Debarge and Sam Cooke.

title: Radio 2 Unwinds with Angela Griffin
description: Angela Griffin helps you reset and decompress, with a Recovery Unwinds Mix from Annie Lennox, Joan Armatrading and Dido.

title: Jo Whiley's Shiny Happy Playlist
description: Jo brings the Halloween vibes, including Olivia Rodrigo, Jamie T and Talking Heads.

title: Jo Whiley's Shiny Happy Playlist
description: Jo brings 30 minutes of feelgood music. Tonight, 6 Music's Indie Forever Morning Session co-host and Maccabees guitarist Felix White joins her to play back-to-back indie hits.

title: Tracks of My Years
description: Mick Jagger and Ronnie Wood from The Rolling Stones join Vernon for a special edition of Tracks Of My Years, taking us through their lives and careers in ten songs.

title: Good Morning Sunday
description: The Reverend Kate Bottley and Jason Mohammad reflect on Remembrance Sunday, with Pause For Thought from The Right Reverend Dr David Walker.

title: Love Songs with Michael Ball
description: Your true stories and favourite love songs with Michael... easy like Sunday morning.

title: Paddy McGuinness
description: Paddy's live from Salford every Sunday morning with The Weekest Link quiz, the Kitchen Tip-Line, Paddy's Timewarp and another BIG question.

title: Elaine Paige on Sunday
description: Putting a pep in your step with show tunes and movie songs from across the decades, plus Pick of the Flicks, your Break A Leg messages, and Elaine's Winter Warmer Double Bill.

title: Sounds of the 70s with Shaun Keaveny
description: Tom Petty's daughter Adria joins Shaun to talk about her dad's 70s music, as his estate releases a new boxset of rare material from the start of his career.

title: Pick of the Pops
description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1980.

title: Pick of the Pops
description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1992.

title: Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour
description: Tony Blackburn spins his personal pick of the hits from across the decades. To listen on most smart speakers just 'ask BBC Sounds to play Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour'.

title: The Paul Gambaccini Collection
description: Gambo showcases Cymru's finest - Tom, Shirley, Aled, Charlotte, Bryn, Kelly, Bonnie, Kathryn and Shakey. All to support Owain's 400-mile bike ride for Children In Need.

title: Radio 2 Unwinds with Angela Griffin
description: Angela Griffin has songs to inspire and relax Owain Wyn Evans, from Mariah Carey, Luther Vandross and Deacon Blue.

title: Radio 2 Unwinds Mix with Angela Griffin
description: Angela Griffin has songs by artists from across the four nations of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. From the likes of Snow Patrol, Shirley Bassey and Travis.
